Name: (CP) Dacar SVE Seasonal anime style portraits
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
FInally done with this one, the most complicated one till now, just couldn't stop myself from giving SVE the love I think it deserves.

[color=#ff0000][size=4]If you were previously using the original Dacar' SVE Portraits make sure to remove it! Having both at the same time will create conflicts and neither will load![/size][/color]

[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Known compatibility Issues:[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]Bigger Backpacks, for some reason Bigger backpacks messes up my Vendor portraits, most likely something to do with SpaceCore. If you are using this mod there's an optional file that uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3130]Scale up 2[/url]﻿[/*]
[/list]
My take on SVE seasonal outfits for cute aesthetic is here! With 6 extra outfits, Egg Festival, Fair, Jellies, Luau, Festival of Ice and Winter Star, and some extras done by yours truly!

This mod also includes :
[list]
[*]new hair styles, one for sophia, with sprites[/*]
[*]one for Susan, portrait only, alongside some toggles.[/*]
[*]a special feature I wanted to add, Claire now show a portrait change after you befriended her enough! This is something I wanted to add so her story has a little more spice to it.[/*]
[/list]
This mod has Wedding Reception protraits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31890]here[/url]﻿! 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/d0qM2TTR/Toggles.png[/img]
[b][i]Sop﻿hia hair style[/i][/b]
[spoiler]Changes Sophia's hair style to a longer version, all portraits have their own sprite.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/SRL3YSN1/All-In-One-Seasonal-SVESophia-Long.png[/img][/spoiler]

[i]Sophia's Winter Style/Ice Festival Outfit[/i]
[spoiler]This mod includes three different outfits for Sophia, it includes the original SVE seasonal winter style, normal SVE outfit and a Custom one I made for Ice festival but really liked so I added it as an option. Due to this I made it so every winter style has it's own Ice festival outfit. By default it goes this way, but the Ice festival outfit can be chosen at will.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/qvDY3Z4r/All-In-One-Seasonal-SVESophia-Winter-Styles.png[/img][/spoiler]
[i]Other toggles[/i]
[spoiler]This other toggles include one for every character so they don't show the new outfits I've made if you want to have others, also I included a renewed version for Older Sophia, with also long hair, a different hairstyle for Susan just in case you want a coilier version and a toggle to have always Post 6 event Claire's portrait.
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mDKByg4b/All-In-One-Seasonal-SVEOther-Toggles.png[/img][/spoiler]

﻿﻿﻿

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6509pQY9/Next-Projects.png[/img]

Next mod will be:

After that I will be making one of this mods if I get the okay, pretty much in this order:
